note: Multiple Registration creates a per-role registration page at /user/register/{rid}. Page definitions live in config object multiple_registration.create_registration_page_form_config, keyed by role id -> {path (URL alias), url (/user/register/{rid}), redirect_path, hidden, form_mode_register, form_mode_edit}. Global options in multiple_registration.common_settings_page_form_config (multiple_registration_disable_main, enable_redirect_to_user_profile_when_user_logged_in, enable_add_user_buttons_on_people_page) and access in multiple_registration.access_settings_page_form_config. Configure route multiple_registration.multiple_registration_list_index (/admin/config/people/multiple_registration). Permission administer multiple_registration. Requires path_alias. Medium/hard cases use namespaced roles (mr_*) and the real config objects.

evals.prompt: Using the multiple_registration module, how do I give a specific role its own user registration page, and what URL does that page live at?
evals.expected_output: From Configuration > People > Multiple registration pages (route multiple_registration.multiple_registration_list_index at /admin/config/people/multiple_registration) add a page for the role. The page is served at /user/register/{rid} (you can give it a friendlier path alias); submitting it registers the user and assigns that role.

evals.prompt: Where does the multiple_registration module store the definition of each per-role registration page, and what fields does each definition contain?
evals.expected_output: In the config object multiple_registration.create_registration_page_form_config, keyed by role id. Each entry holds path (URL alias), url (/user/register/{rid}), redirect_path, hidden, form_mode_register and form_mode_edit.

evals.prompt: With multiple_registration, can I turn off the default /user/register page so people must use a role-specific registration page, and what permission controls the module's admin pages?
evals.expected_output: Yes: the common settings form sets multiple_registration_disable_main (in multiple_registration.common_settings_page_form_config) to disable the default /user/register page. The admin pages are gated by the 'administer multiple_registration' permission.

evals.prompt: This site has a role mr_known that has a Multiple Registration page configured. Inspect the live configuration and state the URL path alias set for that role's registration page.
evals.expected_output: In multiple_registration.create_registration_page_form_config, the mr_known entry has path '/join-mr' (url '/user/register/mr_known'). Read with `drush cget multiple_registration.create_registration_page_form_config mr_known`.

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the Multiple Registration global (common) settings and state whether the option that redirects already-logged-in users away from registration pages to their own profile is currently enabled.
evals.expected_output: It is enabled: multiple_registration.common_settings_page_form_config -> enable_redirect_to_user_profile_when_user_logged_in is 1. Read with `drush cget multiple_registration.common_settings_page_form_config enable_redirect_to_user_profile_when_user_logged_in`.

evals.prompt: This site has a role with machine name mr_task. Using the multiple_registration module, create a dedicated registration page for that role with the URL path alias /signup-task. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: multiple_registration.create_registration_page_form_config has an mr_task entry with path '/signup-task' (and url '/user/register/mr_task'), created via the 'Create Registration Page' form or by editing the config object.

evals.prompt: On this site I want to turn OFF the standard /user/register signup page (using the Multiple Registration module's settings) so people can only register through the role-specific pages. Make that change and save it.
evals.expected_output: multiple_registration.common_settings_page_form_config -> multiple_registration_disable_main is set to 1 (via the Multiple Registration Settings form at /admin/config/people/multiple_registration/settings).
